tools.name: optics
tools.description: Calculate camera geometry, object sampling, exposure and depth of field. Provide exactly one sensor source: camera, sensor, or both manual sensor axes. Camera cannot be combined with manual passport fields. fovMm and wdMm are always required.

tools.name: interface
tools.description: Calculate stream bandwidth and evaluate interface options. Provide either camera or the complete manual stream set widthPx, heightPx, fps, bits, streamType and packed; do not combine the two modes. width and height are independent aliases for widthPx and heightPx, so mixed alias pairs are accepted,

tools.name: linescan
tools.description: Calculate line width, line rate, exposure and confirmed camera modes. widthMm is required. Provide exactly one speed field (speedMmS or speedMMin) and exactly one calculation set (defectMm+nPx or accuracyMm+kPx); mode is inferred when omitted. samplingMode defaults to xy, or to width when longitudin

tools.name: analog
tools.description: Compare one unambiguous competitor model with bounded Hikrobot candidates. Compare one unambiguous competitor model with a bounded set of public Hikrobot candidates.

tools.name: sensors
tools.description: Get a sensor aggregation by exactly one camera model or sensor part. Provide exactly one lookup key: a catalog camera model or a sensor part number.

tools.name: models
tools.description: Search the bounded public catalog projection. Search the bounded public catalog projection by literal model, alias, SKU or slug.
